name: io.github.liujiaao/es-plus
description: Generate runnable Vue 3 / Vue 2 CRUD pages from one JSON config or a natural-language request.

environmentVariables.name: ESPLUS_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool surface to expose: `full` (default, all tools) or `front-door` (the preferred entries — generate_scene / generate_composition / generate_crud plus single-surface fragments, validate/refine/ingest/coverage helpers, and the host-contract tools; the legacy generate_crud_page / generate_crud_schema and the advanced generate_crud_from_config are not registered).
